scenes.text: A breakup ends a relationship. Not every digital connection.
Meet Untangle. Your private guide, with optional AI.
Maya changed her password. But the shared laptop, and their photos? She still has questions.
Six checks connect accounts and photos. Recovery access comes before password changes. Every step stays visible.
Agentic help, with clear roles: AI selects guides and clarifies notes. The app adds preparation. Preview this prepared wording, accept, or undo.
Before changing anything, see what a password change affects, and what it leaves outside. The explanation links to its source.
Keep the steps you choose. An unanswered question stays a question. Reading a guide never marks it reviewed.
Save an encrypted file. Open it later, and your checks, notes, and questions come back. No account to create.
Less guesswork. A clearer next step. And the choice stays yours.
